scientific_question: Can a deterministic residual-energy-adaptive smooth 2x2 detector partition repair every remaining v135 observation-only failure while preserving the same 2A+2A^T shell, variable camera cardinality and camera permutation equivariance?

advisor_alignment.direction: Build and validate on virtual reaction-flow CFD first; migrate to a new laboratory experimental set when it becomes available.
advisor_alignment.current_inputs: Every active camera carries an 18-value reported pose token and each forward/adjoint operator is rebuilt from the corresponding reported geometry.
advisor_alignment.current_stress: The frozen v128 roster contains clean, observation-noise, extrinsic pose, intrinsic calibration and combined perturbations, evaluated with 5, 7, 9 and 12 active cameras.
advisor_alignment.next_required_stress: After this representation gate, separately freeze arbitrary camera add/drop, camera-order permutation, focal/principal-point and extrinsic perturbation tests. Nested camera counts in this diagnostic do not by themselves prove arbitrary camera-set generalization.
advisor_alignment.future_real_data: Keep the clean CFD baseline and use future laboratory displacement images, calibration files and repeated measurements only for a separately frozen migration and final validation gate.

prior_result.interpretation: The fixed smooth local-frequency representation preserved all physical metrics and rescued 571 v134 failures, but 538 observation-only failures remained. Their detector residual energy is broad and spatially displaced, so v136 changes only window location and width using visible K1 residual moments.

data_contract.role: post-open fit-only residual-adaptive representation capacity diagnostic
data_contract.factorized_conditions: The frozen v128 roster of 37 clean, observation-noise, pose, intrinsic and combined conditions.

representation_contract.parent_basis: Exactly the v133 per-active-camera, per-displacement-component DCT-II LL/LH/HL/HH detector directions.
representation_contract.visible_adaptation_input: The per-active-camera and per-displacement-component zero-start CGLS K1 detector residual only.
representation_contract.energy: Square each K1 residual value and normalize over the 16x16 detector for each camera and displacement component.
representation_contract.centre: Residual-energy centroid independently along y and x, clipped to [2.5, 13.5]. A residual with total squared energy at most 1e-30 falls back to centre 8.0.
representation_contract.transition_half_width: clip(1.5 times the residual-energy standard deviation, 3.0, 8.0) independently along y and x; empty residual fallback width is 8.0.
representation_contract.one_dimensional_window: right(u)=sin(pi*clip((u-centre+half_width)/(2*half_width),0,1)/2)^2 and left=1-right; bottom equals right and top equals left.
representation_contract.partition_rule: The four separable nonnegative windows sum to one at every detector pixel within 4e-16.
representation_contract.direction_order: v133 parent direction major, then top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right adaptive window.
representation_contract.basis_count: 32 times the active camera count, hence 160/224/288/384 directions for 5/7/9/12 cameras.
representation_contract.strict_containment: Assigning the same coefficient to all four children of each parent direction reproduces every v133 direction and therefore contains the full v135 fixed-window parent span.
representation_contract.variable_cardinality: The identical residual-moment rule is applied only to active cameras.
representation_contract.camera_permutation_equivariance: Permuting active cameras permutes their residual moments and basis blocks; no camera index has a distinct parameter.
representation_contract.input_proposal: The independently validated v131.1 held-out predicted correction dual restricted to active cameras.
representation_contract.deployment_boundary: Window generation is deployment-visible. Truth-aware coefficient fitting and final candidate selection are opened-fit capacity diagnostics, not deployable estimators.

staged_evaluation.cheap_control_scope: Run the deployment-visible residual-adaptive joint-LS control on all 3700 cells.
staged_evaluation.parent_retention: Retain the independently validated v135 candidate and metrics for the 3162 cells already passing all four per-cell gates.
staged_evaluation.oracle_scope: Run the expensive seven-candidate truth-aware adaptive roster only on the frozen 538 v135 failure indices.
staged_evaluation.scientific_boundary: The final selected result is a truth-aware parent-retention capacity upper bound. It does not establish a deployable coefficient predictor.

objective_roster.finite_weight_objective: Minimize unit-weight relative squared teacher field-lift error plus projection_weight times relative squared teacher projected-lift error in the adaptive basis.
objective_roster.projection_only_objective: Minimize relative squared teacher projected-lift error with zero field weight.
objective_roster.ridge_scale: Mean diagonal of each candidate unregularized weighted Gram matrix.
objective_roster.formal_solver: float64 direct solve of the regularized normal equations
objective_roster.independent_solver: float64 symmetric eigendecomposition of the same frozen equations
objective_roster.canonicalization: Normalize active coefficients to unit RMS and orient the common sign toward nonnegative projected-target inner product.
objective_roster.selector: Prefer any all-four-metric feasible candidate by minimum worst ratio, then observation ratio and roster order; otherwise minimize observation among three-physical-metric feasible candidates; otherwise use physical minimax.
objective_roster.truth_boundary: Teacher targets, final metric ratios and the selector use already-opened fit truth only to test capacity.

cheap_control.name: deployment-visible residual-adaptive per-camera/component joint least squares
cheap_control.definition: For each active camera and displacement component, jointly fit the 16 adaptive band-window directions to the visible K1 detector residual with a fixed ridge, concatenate all groups, normalize to unit RMS and use the unchanged observable line search.
cheap_control.purpose: Test whether deterministic residual adaptation already explains any capacity gain.

accuracy_gate.grouping: Each complete trajectory separately over all 740 cells.
accuracy_gate.truth_aware_cell_pass_requirement: All four metric ratios must be at most 1.05 for every one of the 3700 opened cells.

call_accounting.candidate_online_shell: zero-start CGLS K1 plus one selected exact A_g^T lift and one exact A_g projection
call_accounting.window_generation_cost: Per-camera residual moments and elementwise detector windows only; no exact operator call.
call_accounting.cheap_control_coefficient_cost: Detector-space 16x16 group solves only; no exact operator call.
call_accounting.offline_capacity_work: Truth-aware adaptive-basis batching, seven solves and candidate evaluation are diagnostic-only and excluded from deployable cost claims.
call_accounting.parent_retention_boundary: Inherited v135 cells retain their already validated 2A+2A^T shell.

decision_rule.cheap_control_pass_action: If the cheap control alone passes 3700/3700 and all five trajectories, attribute the result to the deterministic control and do not claim learned advantage.
decision_rule.oracle_pass_action: If the parent-retention adaptive oracle passes 3700/3700 and all five trajectories while the cheap control fails, record residual-adaptive representation development headroom and authorize only one separately frozen minimal permutation-equivariant observation/geometry-only coefficient predictor under complete-trajectory LOTO.
decision_rule.oracle_fail_action: Close this residual-moment adaptive 2x2 representation. Do not enlarge CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet; inspect the remaining failure mechanism before choosing another representation.
decision_rule.inference_limit: Failure does not prove continuous adaptive-span impossibility, and success does not prove coefficient predictability, arbitrary camera-set generalization, speed, external generalization or real-BOST validity.

source_contract.truth_gauge: interior mean removed with a zero boundary support mask
